extracted.name: Pineapple salsa
extracted.description: Ideal for a barbecue, combine diced pineapple with red chilli, red onion, tomato and parsley to make this zingy side dish. Leave to macerate a little before serving
ingredient_lines: 1 red chilli finely chopped (deseeded if you like it milder)
instruction_lines: Combine everything together in a bowl and leave for 20 mins to macerate a little then serve. Season to taste.
